meta_description: D&S Electricians in Leeds offers domestic and commercial electrical work, repairs, installations and maintenance. Call 07967 555298 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: From rewires to emergency repairs, D&S Electricians diagnose and fix problems fast across Leeds and surrounding areas.
services_subhead: Whether you need a full rewire, emergency fault-finding, or routine maintenance, we handle domestic and commercial electrical work with precision and care.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Power failures, burnt-out circuits, or electrical faults? We diagnose and repair on the same day. Available 24/7 for urgent jobs.

services.title: Complete House Rewires
services.desc: Old wiring putting your home at risk? We replace outdated systems with modern, safe cabling throughout your property, with full testing and certification.

services.title: Fusebox & Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Upgrade from an old fuse board to a modern safety switch unit. Improves safety, adds RCD protection, and future-proofs your home.

services.title: Fault-Finding & Testing
services.desc: Blown fuses, flickering lights, or tripping switches? We use diagnostic equipment to locate the root cause and fix it properly, not just patch it.

services.title: New Circuits & Socket Installation
services.desc: Adding sockets, extending circuits, or installing specialist wiring for kitchens and bathrooms. All work completed to Building Regulations standards.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Electrical
services.desc: From office rewires to industrial maintenance contracts. We understand business needs and minimise downtime with swift, professional solutions.

about_pullquote: I started D&S because I was tired of seeing customers overcharged for dodgy electrical work.
about_para_1: D&S Electricians was founded 15 years ago in Leeds with one mission: deliver reliable, honest electrical work at a fair price. We've built our reputation on showing up on time, explaining what's wrong in plain English, and fixing it right the first time. Our team is NICEIC approved and carries all the tools and parts needed to diagnose and repair most jobs on the same visit.
about_para_2: We specialise in emergency callouts — burst into a house with no power at 10pm, and we'll be there. But we also take pride in planned work: rewires, upgrades, and maintenance that keep your home or business safe for years. Over 1,200 jobs completed across Leeds, and most of our new customers come through word-of-mouth from happy repeat clients.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Lost all power on a Saturday evening. Phoned D&S and they were here within 45 minutes. Turned out a faulty MCB in the fusebox. Fixed it straight away, fair price, and really knew what they were doing. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had the whole house rewired by D&S last spring. Professional lads, kept the place tidy, and they explained everything as they went. Finished on time and the quality of work is first-class. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Emma R.

reviews.text: Called them for a flickering light issue and they diagnosed it as a dodgy connection in the consumer unit. Could have been dangerous. They sorted it, issued a safety cert, and charged a fair rate. Really grateful for their honesty.
reviews.author: James K.
